# Scale With Ads™

> Scale With Ads™ is a done-for-you client acquisition agency. We install a complete system (Meta Ads, ad creatives, sales funnels, CRM, AI follow-up and lead qualification) into businesses already making $10,000+/month, and guarantee in a written agreement to double their revenue in 90 days, or keep working at no management fee until we do.

Founded and led by Vaishali Kapoor (Founder) and Gaurav Kapoor (Co-Founder). Website: https://www.scalewithads.us

## What we do

- Offer positioning and messaging strategy
- Meta (Facebook and Instagram) Ads management
- Ad creatives, short-form video ads, UGC and VSL scripting
- Sales funnels and landing pages
- CRM setup, AI follow-up automations, SMS and email sequences
- Lead qualification and calendar booking

Who it is for: agency owners, coaches, consultants, high-ticket service providers and B2B founders generating $10,000+/month. We work across 30+ verticals, including marketing agencies, B2B services, home services (roofing, HVAC, solar), legal and personal injury, healthcare, real estate and e-commerce.

Clients own 100% of every asset we build. Onboarding and system build take roughly 14 to 21 days from kickoff to live campaigns.

## Frequently asked questions

- **Who is this for?** Our system is built specifically for agency owners, coaches, consultants, high-ticket service providers, and B2B founders already generating $10,000+/month looking to scale predictably.
- **Is this completely Done-For-You?** Yes, 100%. We handle offer positioning, copy, creative design, sales funnel build, Meta ads management, CRM setup, AI automations, and lead qualification.
- **Do I own everything?** Yes. Every single asset we build—funnels, copy, ad creatives, CRM sequences, and customer data—belongs 100% to your business with no lock-ins.
- **How long does implementation take?** Complete onboarding and system build takes roughly 14 to 21 days from our kickoff call to launching your live campaigns.
- **What industries do you work with?** We work across 30+ verticals including digital marketing agencies, B2B services, home services (roofing, HVAC, solar), legal, healthcare, real estate, and e-commerce.
- **What happens on the strategy call?** We perform a audit of your current client acquisition bottlenecks, review your offer, and outline a customized 90-day growth roadmap for your business.
- **How is this different from a marketing agency?** Traditional agencies only run ads and hand off raw leads. We build a complete client acquisition ecosystem including qualification, CRM, AI follow-ups, and a 90-day written guarantee.
- **What's included?** Offer positioning, messaging strategy, Meta ads management, ad creatives, sales funnels, CRM setup, AI follow-up automations, SMS/email sequences, lead qualification, and calendar booking.
